task-1.title: Install SyncToDo on Phone & Tablet
task-1.notes: Open the app URL in Safari or Chrome, tap Share / Settings, and select "Add to Home Screen".

task-2.title: Test offline sync mode
task-2.notes: Turn off Wi-Fi on your phone, check off this task, turn Wi-Fi back on, and watch it auto-sync to your laptop!

task-3.title: Switch between the 4 custom looks
task-3.notes: Try Nordic Glass, Cyber Matrix, Clean Studio, and Warm Journal directly from the settings bar.
